full_prompt_en: A square historical oil painting shows two richly dressed young figures standing close together before a brick garden wall covered with dark leaves and flowers. The figure on the left, with short dark hair, leans slightly toward the other and holds a small rounded object in both hands. A black drape falls across a gold and russet patterned garment, whose broad sleeves are filled with intricate scrolling ornament. The figure on the right has a mass of copper-red curls and looks back calmly, one pale hand resting beside a round stone or fruit at the lower edge. Her fitted burgundy bodice and wide sleeves combine red brocade with cream linen, every seam and fold rendered patiently. Their faces are shown in clear three-quarter profile and meet across the central gap, giving an intimate focus to a composition otherwise dense with textile and foliage. Behind them, warm brick is partly hidden by olive-green leaves, faded yellow and rust-colored blossoms, and trailing stems. The garden details form a richly patterned but shallow background rather than a distant landscape. The overall palette is deep and autumnal: wine red, burnt sienna, old gold, olive, black, and a few small pale skin and linen areas. Paint is smooth and controlled across the faces, while fabric ornament and leaf clusters carry finer visible detail. Soft, warm light arrives from the front left, lifting cheeks and cream collars without making sharp cast shadows; dark clothing and foliage remain saturated rather than empty black. The tightly filled frame and measured poses create a romantic, contemplative mood, with the exchanged gaze holding stillness amid the elaborate decoration.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形历史题材油画呈现两名身着华服的年轻人紧挨着站在覆有深色叶片与花朵的砖砌花园墙前。左侧短黑发人物略向对方倾身，双手捧着一件小圆物。黑色披布搭过一件金色与赤褐色图案衣服，宽袖满是复杂卷纹装饰。右侧人物有一团铜红卷发，平静回望，一只浅色手停在下缘一块圆石或果实旁。她贴身的酒红色衣身与宽袖把红织锦和奶油白亚麻结合起来，每道接缝与褶层都耐心绘出。两人的脸以清楚的四分之三侧面相对，在中央间隙中交会，使纺织品与叶丛密布的构图有了亲密焦点。身后暖砖墙部分被橄榄绿叶、褪黄与锈色花、垂挂枝茎盖住。花园细节形成华丽图案化的浅背景，而非遥远风景。整体配色深沉而带秋意：葡萄酒红、焦赭、旧金、橄榄绿、黑色，以及少量浅肤色与亚麻白。脸部油彩平滑受控，衣纹与叶团承载更精细可见细节。柔和暖光从左前方照来，提亮脸颊和奶油色衣领，却不投下尖锐阴影；深衣与叶丛仍然饱和，并非空黑。紧密填满的画框与有分寸的姿态制造浪漫、沉思的气氛，互相凝视的视线在繁复装饰中保持静止。
style_prompt_en: A detailed historical oil-painting treatment uses smooth, controlled modeling in the central pale areas and meticulous decorative handling across heavier surrounding textures. Wine red, russet, old gold, olive green, and near-black fill most of the frame, with cream highlights reserved for small visual rests. Rich patterned planes and curling organic forms interlock against a shallow warm ground, leaving little empty space. Paired large masses lean toward a narrow central gap, so the eye settles on the quiet exchange between them before exploring the dense ornament. Edges are clean around focal contours but soften among layered foliage and woven detail. Soft frontal warmth lifts selected planes without harsh cast shadows; deep values remain colored and textured. The brushwork is careful rather than loose, with textile-like motifs, minute leaf shapes, and subtle glazing giving the surface an old-master richness. The overall rhythm is intimate and compressed, balancing intricate decoration with still, clear central relationships.
style_prompt_zh: 细致历史油画处理在中央浅色区域使用平滑、受控的塑形，在周围更厚重纹理上采用精密装饰性描绘。葡萄酒红、赤褐、旧金、橄榄绿与近黑填满画面大部，奶油色亮点只留作小片视觉停顿。富于图案的平面与卷曲有机形体在浅暖底上交错，几乎不留空白。成对的大体块向狭窄中央间隙倾斜，使视线先落在两者之间安静的关系，再探索密集纹饰。焦点轮廓边缘清楚，层叠叶丛和织物细节间则柔化。正面暖柔光抬亮选定平面，没有硬投影；深暗明度仍有色彩和纹理。笔触谨慎而非松散，织物般纹样、微小叶形与细腻罩染让表面具有古典绘画的丰厚感。整体节奏亲密而压缩，在复杂装饰与静止、清楚的中央关系间取得平衡。
theme_en: Two richly dressed young figures quietly facing each other beside a garden wall
theme_zh: 两名身着华服的年轻人在花园墙前安静相望
name: Valentine Cameron Prinsep
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
